entries.meaningZh: 桃金娘花〔夏威夷语借词〕
entries.en: She tucked a lehua behind her ear before stepping out to join the dancers.
entries.zh: 她把一朵桃金娘花别在耳后，才走出去加入舞者的行列。

entries.en: The exhibition pairs Swabian folk costumes with photographs of the people who wore them.
entries.zh: 展览把斯瓦比亚民间服饰与穿着这些服饰的人们的照片放在一起展示。

entries.en: Osbourne insisted on taking the cracked teapot home rather than leaving it in the rubbish.
entries.zh: 奥斯本坚持把那个裂了的茶壶带回家，不肯把它留在垃圾堆里。

entries.en: Norden had hidden the birthday present so well that he could no longer find it.
entries.zh: 诺登把生日礼物藏得太好，连自己也找不到了。

entries.en: Her essay compares postclassic Greek prose with the earlier texts that shaped her reading.
entries.zh: 她的论文把古典时代后的希腊散文与那些影响了她阅读的较早文本作了比较。

entries.en: Midler arrived with a ladder but discovered that the broken window was already accessible from inside.
entries.zh: 米德勒带着梯子到了，却发现从屋里已经可以够到那扇破窗户。

entries.en: McCarron stopped the music to ask whose phone was vibrating against the piano.
entries.zh: 麦卡伦停下音乐，询问是谁的手机正贴着钢琴震动。

entries.en: Maxey offered to mend the torn sail if we could find somewhere dry to spread it.
entries.zh: 马克西提出，只要我们能找到干燥的地方把帆铺开，就帮忙补好破帆。

entries.en: The parcel from Manaus contained our missing sketchbook, wrapped in an old cotton shirt.
entries.zh: 从马瑙斯寄来的包裹里装着我们丢失的速写本，外面裹着一件旧棉衬衫。

entries.en: The museum exhibit on Kristallnacht left the visitors silent for several minutes.
entries.zh: 博物馆里关于水晶之夜的展览让参观者沉默了好几分钟。

entries.en: Kearton took the photograph from its frame to check whether anything was written on the back.
entries.zh: 基尔顿把照片从相框里取出来，查看背面是否写着什么。

entries.en: Hauer could hear someone knocking, but the fallen bookcase prevented him from opening the door.
entries.zh: 豪尔听见有人敲门，可倒下的书柜挡住了他，门打不开。

entries.en: Goldblum had packed the chess pieces separately and forgotten which bag held the board.
entries.zh: 戈德布卢姆把棋子另装在一处，却忘了棋盘放在哪个包里。

entries.en: Esmond lowered his voice when he realised that the child beside him had fallen asleep.
entries.zh: 埃斯蒙德发现身旁的孩子睡着了，便放低了声音。

entries.en: Elysees tried three different keys before noticing that the cupboard door was not locked.
entries.zh: 埃利塞试了三把不同的钥匙，才发现橱柜门根本没锁。

entries.en: I found the old Elmo camera underneath a pile of scarves in the wardrobe.
entries.zh: 我在衣柜里的一堆围巾下面找到了那台旧爱慕照相机。

entries.en: Downie held a bowl beneath the leak while the others searched for a larger bucket.
entries.zh: 其他人在找更大的水桶时，唐尼拿着碗接住漏下来的水。

entries.en: Clarice wanted to finish the crossword before anyone unfolded the newspaper to read the news.
entries.zh: 克拉丽斯想赶在有人展开报纸看新闻之前，把填字游戏做完。

entries.en: Carswell had brought enough plates for everyone, but only half as many forks.
entries.zh: 卡斯韦尔带来的盘子够所有人用，叉子却只有盘子数量的一半。

entries.en: Carita lifted the rug to see whether the missing coin had rolled underneath it.
entries.zh: 卡里塔掀起地毯，想看看那枚不见了的硬币是否滚到了下面。

entries.en: The researchers could not assess restenosis reliably because several follow-up images were missing.
entries.zh: 由于缺少几张随访影像，研究人员无法可靠地评估再狭窄情况。

entries.en: We returned to Campsie for the suitcase that our friend had kept in her hallway.
entries.zh: 我们回到恳思，去取朋友一直放在她家走廊里的那个行李箱。

entries.en: Braine asked me to hold the curtain aside while he examined the damaged window catch.
entries.zh: 布雷恩请我把窗帘拉到一边，好让他检查损坏的窗扣。

entries.en: The illustrator made the preauricular scar less prominent in the second version of the portrait.
entries.zh: 插画师在第二版肖像里把耳前的疤痕画得不那么明显了。

entries.en: Blackford found the receipt but could not remember which of the two kettles it belonged to.
entries.zh: 布莱克福德找到了收据，却想不起它对应的是两只水壶中的哪一只。

entries.en: Benvenuto had left room for dessert until he saw the enormous serving of soup.
entries.zh: 本韦努托原本还留着肚子吃甜点，直到看见端来的那一大份汤。

entries.en: Basie moved the lamp so that its reflection would no longer hide the photograph.
entries.zh: 巴锡挪动了台灯，好让反光不再遮住照片。

entries.en: We could see the symbiote more clearly after adjusting the microscope's focus.
entries.zh: 完成显微镜调焦后，我们能更清楚地看到那个共生生物了。

entries.en: Her study compares parental behaviour in oviparous animals without treating them as a single uniform group.
entries.zh: 她的研究比较卵生动物的亲代行为，但不把它们视为一个完全一致的群体。

entries.en: The pharmacist set aside the damaged fluconazole package and checked the rest of the delivery.
entries.zh: 药剂师把包装损坏的氟康唑放到一边，又检查了其余到货物品。

entries.en: Womack had borrowed a sewing machine, but its foot pedal was still at the neighbour's house.
entries.zh: 沃马克借来了一台缝纫机，可脚踏板还留在邻居家里。

entries.en: Sheron tied the loose gate shut with a scarf before going to find some rope.
entries.zh: 谢伦先用围巾把松动的门绑住，才去找绳子。

entries.en: Our friend in Rivoli sent back the borrowed coat with a button sewn on its sleeve.
entries.zh: 我们在里沃利的朋友寄回了借去的外套，袖子上缝着一颗纽扣。

entries.en: Pelling wanted the table moved outside, although rain was already tapping against the window.
entries.zh: 佩林想把桌子搬到外面，尽管雨点已经在敲打窗户了。

entries.en: They photographed the fracture in the superalloy blade before moving it to the storage room.
entries.zh: 他们先拍下那片高温合金叶片上的断口，才把它搬到储藏室。

entries.en: Lynton reached for the salt and knocked his own drawing into the bowl of soup.
entries.zh: 林顿伸手拿盐，把自己的画碰进了汤碗里。

entries.en: Kinnaird blamed the draught until we discovered that the candle had simply run out of wax.
entries.zh: 金奈尔德一直怪穿堂风，直到我们发现只是蜡烛的蜡烧完了。

entries.en: Holcombe brought a folding chair because the invitation warned that seats would be limited.
entries.zh: 邀请函提醒座位有限，霍尔库姆便带来了一把折叠椅。

entries.en: Gerhardt tried to straighten the photograph without disturbing the vase balanced beside its frame.
entries.zh: 格哈特试着把照片摆正，又不想碰动摆在相框旁边的花瓶。

entries.en: Only one image showed the edge of the subretinal space clearly enough for the drawing.
entries.zh: 只有一张影像把视网膜下间隙的边缘显示得足够清楚，可以供绘图使用。

entries.en: Fredric had promised to collect the cake, but nobody had told him which bakery to visit.
entries.zh: 弗雷德里克答应去取蛋糕，可没人告诉他该去哪家面包店。

entries.en: The engineer compared the thermographic images before deciding where to inspect the damaged panel.
entries.zh: 工程师先比较了温度记录图，再决定检查受损面板的哪个位置。

entries.en: The biopolymer film tore while we were trying to stretch it across the frame.
entries.zh: 我们试着把生物聚合物薄膜绷到框架上时，它裂开了。

entries.meaningZh: 破坏骨的〔破骨细胞相关〕
entries.en: The team compared osteoclastic activity across the images without drawing conclusions from colour alone.
entries.zh: 团队比较了各张影像中的破骨细胞活动，没有仅凭颜色就下结论。

entries.en: Ms Branco saved the broken handle, hoping that someone could attach it to the jug again.
entries.zh: 布兰科女士留着断下来的把手，希望有人能把它重新装到水罐上。

entries.en: Mr Bacher unfolded the map on the floor because the table was covered with wet paintings.
entries.zh: 桌上摆满了还没干的画，巴彻先生便把地图铺在了地板上。

entries.en: The illustrator enlarged the sphenopalatine foramen so that its outline remained visible in the diagram.
entries.zh: 插画师把图中的蝶腭孔放大，让它的轮廓仍然清晰可见。

entries.meaningZh: 女巡警〔主要为美国用语〕
entries.en: The patrolwoman stayed beside the lost child while her colleague contacted the family.
entries.zh: 女巡警守在走失的孩子身旁，她的同事则联系孩子的家人。

entries.en: She opposed the substitutive use of recordings in a course built around live discussion.
entries.zh: 她反对在一门以现场讨论为核心的课程中，用录音来代替现场讨论。

entries.en: There was enough paneer for dinner, but we had forgotten to buy any rice.
entries.zh: 印度奶酪够晚饭吃，可我们忘了买米。

entries.en: The drawing showed the teosinte clearly, but the surrounding plants remained unfinished pencil outlines.
entries.zh: 画中的墨西哥类蜀黍已经很清晰，周围的植物却还只是未完成的铅笔轮廓。

entries.en: The illustrator redrew the coronavirus after comparing several electron micrographs taken from different angles.
entries.zh: 插画师比较了几张从不同角度拍摄的电子显微照片后，重新画了那个冠状病毒。

entries.en: Her thesis on biparental care includes detailed observations of the nest over several weeks.
entries.zh: 她关于双亲照料的论文包括对那个巢持续数周的详细观察。

entries.en: A loose wire had slipped behind the microswitch, making it difficult to replace the cover.
entries.zh: 一根松动的电线滑到了微动开关后面，让盖子难以装回去。

entries.meaningZh: 发病的〔与发病过程有关〕
entries.en: The reviewers disagreed about the pathogenetic explanation offered for the unusual findings.
entries.zh: 评审者对针对那些异常发现提出的发病机制方面的解释意见不一。

entries.en: We untangled the lonicera from the broken trellis before carrying the wooden pieces away.
entries.zh: 我们先把忍冬从破损的花架上解开，才搬走那些木片。

entries.en: The damaged pedipalp was partly hidden beneath the spider in the first photograph.
entries.zh: 第一张照片中，那只蜘蛛受损的脚须有一部分被身躯遮住了。

entries.en: In the old novel, a Eurocrat loses the briefcase containing his carefully prepared speech.
entries.zh: 那部旧小说中，一位欧洲经济共同体官员弄丢了装着精心准备的讲稿的公文包。

entries.en: The observer recorded each episode of stereotypy without guessing what had triggered it.
entries.zh: 观察者记录了每一次刻板行为，没有猜测是什么触发了它。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked whether the delivery included the requested fibrinolytic before signing the receipt.
entries.zh: 药剂师先核实到货物品中是否包括所需的溶纤维蛋白药，才签收。

entries.en: The grant for onchocerciasis research covered field travel, but not the proposed laboratory renovations.
entries.zh: 盘尾丝虫病研究的拨款涵盖了实地差旅费用，却不包括拟议中的实验室翻修。

entries.en: The student shaded the subperiosteal deposits differently from the surrounding bone in her drawing.
entries.zh: 那位学生在图中用不同的阴影区分骨膜下沉积物与周围的骨组织。

entries.en: Yarwood had borrowed my bicycle without noticing that the basket was full of fragile jars.
entries.zh: 亚伍德借走我的自行车时，没有注意到车篮里装满了易碎的罐子。

entries.en: The exhibition places drawings of Achaemenid royal reliefs beside the notebooks used to study them.
entries.zh: 展览把阿契美尼德王族浮雕的绘图放在研究这些浮雕时使用的笔记本旁边。

entries.en: Winson had forgotten his reading glasses and asked me to read the letter aloud.
entries.zh: 温森忘了带阅读眼镜，便请我把信念给他听。

entries.en: Wickens wanted to keep the enormous box because the cat had already fallen asleep inside.
entries.zh: 威肯斯想留下那个大盒子，因为猫已经在里面睡着了。

entries.en: Valentina stopped stirring the soup when she heard her name called from the doorway.
entries.zh: 瓦伦蒂娜听见门口有人叫她的名字，便停下了搅汤的动作。

entries.en: Thomason had replaced the missing buttons with four that did not quite match the coat.
entries.zh: 托马森用四颗与外套不太相配的纽扣，补上了缺失的纽扣。

entries.en: Tannenbaum asked the choir to sing once without the piano so he could hear the quieter voices.
entries.zh: 坦嫩鲍姆请合唱团不带钢琴伴奏唱一遍，以便听清较轻的歌声。

entries.en: The old destructor stood behind the depot, partly hidden by abandoned carts and weeds.
entries.zh: 那座旧垃圾焚毁炉位于仓库后面，一部分被废弃的手推车和杂草遮住了。

entries.en: Stockhausen could not shut the suitcase until we removed the pair of muddy boots.
entries.zh: 我们拿出那双沾泥的靴子后，斯托克豪森才合得上行李箱。

entries.en: Solana had remembered the candles but left the birthday cake on his kitchen counter.
entries.zh: 索拉纳记得带蜡烛，却把生日蛋糕留在了自家厨房的台面上。

entries.en: Mrs Scarlatti asked us to leave the damaged frame intact until she had photographed it.
entries.zh: 斯卡拉蒂太太请我们先保留受损画框的原样，等她拍过照片再说。

entries.en: The gardener moved the potted heuchera aside to make room for the newly repaired bench.
entries.zh: 园丁把那盆矾根属植物移到一边，给刚修好的长凳腾出地方。

entries.en: Ramage wanted the parcel weighed again because the first reading seemed much too high.
entries.zh: 拉梅奇希望给包裹重新称重，因为第一次的读数似乎高得离谱。

entries.en: Porteous returned the ladder with a note warning that its lowest rung had come loose.
entries.zh: 波蒂厄斯归还梯子时附了一张字条，提醒最下面的一根横档松了。

entries.en: Pirie searched every drawer before remembering that he had lent the scissors to a neighbour.
entries.zh: 皮里翻遍了每个抽屉，才想起剪刀借给邻居了。

entries.en: Mordechai had brought his own cup because the last gathering had run short of mugs.
entries.zh: 上次聚会的杯子不够用，莫迪凯这次便带来了自己的杯子。

entries.en: The laboratory kept nonsterile equipment on a separate trolley while the room was being reorganised.
entries.zh: 实验室重新整理房间时，把非无菌设备放在了另一辆推车上。

entries.en: We left Montreux with an extra suitcase full of the books our friend had lent us.
entries.zh: 离开蒙特勒时，我们多带了一只行李箱，里面装满了朋友借给我们的书。

entries.en: Mitty borrowed my umbrella and returned it with the missing glove tied to its handle.
entries.zh: 米蒂借走了我的伞，归还时把那只丢失的手套绑在了伞柄上。

entries.en: She lent me the tractate on the condition that I kept her handwritten notes inside it.
entries.zh: 她把那篇短论著借给我，条件是我要把她的手写笔记留在里面。

entries.en: Meyrick had planned a quiet lunch, but the neighbour arrived carrying a broken accordion.
entries.zh: 梅里克原想安静地吃顿午饭，邻居却带着一架坏手风琴来了。

entries.meaningZh: 白细胞碱性磷酸酶活性〔缩写〕
entries.en: A smudged decimal point made the LAPA result impossible to interpret with confidence.
entries.zh: 一个模糊的小数点让人无法有把握地解读那项白细胞碱性磷酸酶活性结果。

entries.en: We sketched the old Martello tower from the path rather than crossing the muddy field.
entries.zh: 我们在小路上画了那座旧马特洛塔的速写，没有穿过泥泞的田地。

entries.en: The student coloured the paraspinal muscles blue to distinguish them from the bones.
entries.zh: 那位学生把脊柱旁的肌肉涂成蓝色，以便与骨骼区分。

entries.en: Lyttleton wanted the broken chair repaired before the visitors arrived, not hidden in the shed.
entries.zh: 利特尔顿希望在访客到来之前修好那把坏椅子，而不是把它藏进棚屋。

entries.en: Luft kept the empty tin because its lid fitted the box of loose buttons perfectly.
entries.zh: 勒夫特留着那个空铁罐，因为它的盖子正好能盖住那盒散装纽扣。

entries.en: Loveday discovered the missing earring while shaking sand out of her folded beach towel.
entries.zh: 洛芙迪抖落折好的沙滩巾里的沙子时，发现了那只丢失的耳环。

entries.en: The notebook contained sketches of laval ridges seen from the valley floor.
entries.zh: 笔记本里有从谷底所见的熔岩山脊的速写。

entries.en: Larsson had measured the doorway but forgotten that the wardrobe's feet could not be removed.
entries.zh: 拉尔森量过门口，却忘了衣柜的脚无法拆卸。

entries.en: Khyber wrapped the cracked mirror in a blanket before carrying it down the narrow stairs.
entries.zh: 希贝尔先用毯子裹住裂了的镜子，才把它搬下狭窄的楼梯。

entries.en: Jacek offered to fetch the forgotten tickets while the rest of us waited beside the fountain.
entries.zh: 亚采克提出去取忘带的票，我们其余人则在喷泉旁等着。

entries.en: Halloran had promised to bring a salad, so nobody expected the enormous pot of soup.
entries.zh: 哈洛伦答应带沙拉来，因此没人料到会有那一大锅汤。

entries.en: Gosden searched the coat pockets again after finding that the spare key would not turn.
entries.zh: 戈斯登发现备用钥匙转不动，便又翻找了一遍外套口袋。

entries.en: Ettore placed the empty cage on the table and asked where the bird had gone.
entries.zh: 埃托雷把空笼子放在桌上，询问鸟去了哪里。

entries.en: Mr Ensor had labelled every box except the one containing the kettle and cups.
entries.zh: 恩索尔先生给每个箱子都贴了标签，唯独漏了装水壶和杯子的那个。

entries.en: Dafoe hung the wet coat above the bath rather than leave it dripping in the hallway.
entries.zh: 达福把湿外套挂在浴缸上方，没有让它留在走廊里滴水。

entries.en: Conley could not decide which painting to keep, so we left both frames on the table.
entries.zh: 康利拿不定主意要留哪幅画，我们便把两个画框都留在了桌上。

entries.en: Without a time scale, we could not compare the two tyrosinase activity curves.
entries.zh: 由于缺少时间刻度，我们无法比较那两条酪氨酸酶活性曲线。

entries.en: The suitcase we left in Bukhara arrived home with a carefully folded note inside.
entries.zh: 我们留在布哈拉的行李箱送到了家，里面放着一张仔细折好的字条。

entries.en: Branston had replaced the torn map with one too large to fit in his coat pocket.
entries.zh: 布兰斯顿换掉了破地图，新换的那张却太大，放不进他的外套口袋。

entries.en: Birdsall left the cake uncovered because the only available lid was still covered in paint.
entries.zh: 伯索尔没有盖住蛋糕，因为唯一能用的盖子上还沾满油漆。

entries.en: The chart omitted toxaphene because its measurements used a different unit from the other results.
entries.zh: 图表没有列入毒杀芬，因为它的测量值所用单位与其他结果不同。

entries.en: Ms Andrey asked for a smaller table so that the guests could move around the room.
entries.zh: 安德烈女士要了一张较小的桌子，好让客人们能在房间里走动。

entries.en: Alisdair had found the matching sock, but the bus was already pulling away from the stop.
entries.zh: 阿利斯代尔找到了配对的那只袜子，可公交车已经开始驶离车站了。

entries.en: The vowel's first formant was difficult to distinguish from the background noise in the recording.
entries.zh: 录音中，那个元音的第一共振峰很难与背景噪声区分开。

entries.en: The researchers disagreed about whether the faint change in the images indicated remineralization.
entries.zh: 研究人员对于影像中微弱的变化是否表明发生了再矿化，意见不一。

entries.en: Woodburn brought the portrait closer to the window to examine the tear near its lower edge.
entries.zh: 伍德伯恩把肖像拿到更靠近窗户的地方，查看下缘附近的破口。

entries.en: Mr Tryon was halfway through his breakfast when the dog returned with the missing shoe.
entries.zh: 泰伦先生的早饭吃到一半，狗把那只不见了的鞋带回来了。

entries.en: Rosina asked me to read the recipe aloud while she searched for the measuring jug.
entries.zh: 罗西娜一边找量杯，一边请我把食谱念给她听。

entries.en: Roja had taken the wrong shopping bag and discovered a pair of boots instead of vegetables.
entries.zh: 罗娅拿错了购物袋，发现里面不是蔬菜，而是一双靴子。

entries.en: Renata wanted a photograph of the finished quilt before anyone spread it across the bed.
entries.zh: 勒娜特希望在有人把做好的被子铺到床上之前，先拍张照片。

entries.en: We returned to Nazca for the parcel our friend had left with the shopkeeper.
entries.zh: 我们回到纳斯卡，去取朋友留在店主那里的包裹。

entries.en: Lecter found a quiet corner where the children could finish their drawings without blocking the doorway.
entries.zh: 莱克特找了个安静角落，好让孩子们在那里画完画，又不堵住门口。

entries.en: Keren left the umbrella open in the bath because rainwater was still running from its edges.
entries.zh: 克伦把伞撑开放在浴缸里，因为伞边还在往下淌雨水。

entries.en: Kaur had brought enough string to mend the handle, but the basket itself was badly split.
entries.zh: 考尔带的绳子够修把手，可篮子本身已经裂得很厉害了。

entries.en: Our friend in Invercargill sent the missing keys back with a photograph of the garden.
entries.zh: 我们在因弗卡吉尔的朋友寄回了丢失的钥匙，还附了一张花园的照片。

entries.en: We found the missing picnic basket at Bondi Beach, exactly where we had left our shoes.
entries.zh: 我们在邦代海滩找到了丢失的野餐篮，就在之前放鞋的那个地方。

entries.en: The biography of Augustine Birrell was too damaged to lend, so I read it in the library.
entries.zh: 那本奥古斯丁·比勒尔传记破损得无法外借，我便在图书馆里读了它。

entries.en: Binoche moved the plant aside and discovered that its pot had hidden a crack in the sill.
entries.zh: 比诺什把植物移到一边，发现花盆遮住了窗台上的一道裂缝。

entries.en: The portrait of Joseph Brodsky hung too high for us to examine its damaged frame.
entries.zh: 约瑟夫·布罗茨基的肖像挂得太高，我们没法仔细查看它受损的画框。

entries.en: Our friends in Abbeville sent the repaired clock back in a box lined with old towels.
entries.zh: 我们在阿布维尔的朋友把修好的钟寄了回来，箱子里垫着旧毛巾。

entries.en: One moule had slipped from the platter and landed beside my empty glass.
entries.zh: 一只贻贝从大盘子里滑了出来，落在我的空杯子旁边。

entries.en: The farmer moved the injured wooler to a separate pen where he could watch it more closely.
entries.zh: 农场主把那只受伤的毛用动物移到单独的围栏里，以便更仔细地观察它。

entries.en: Vann had saved the torn envelope because the address was the only clue we had.
entries.zh: 范恩留着那个破信封，因为上面的地址是我们仅有的线索。

entries.en: Tredegar had promised a quiet game of chess, but an argument began over the missing pieces.
entries.zh: 特里迪加答应安静地下盘棋，可大家却为丢失的棋子争执起来。

entries.en: Severus brought an extra candle after noticing how difficult it was to read the handwritten menu.
entries.zh: 西弗勒斯发现那份手写菜单很难看清，便又拿来了一支蜡烛。

entries.en: Schmid kept the chipped plate because it was the last one that matched the old teapot.
entries.zh: 施密德留着那只有缺口的盘子，因为它是最后一只与旧茶壶配套的盘子。

entries.en: Rydal wanted to move the bench before the roots made it impossible to lift.
entries.zh: 吕达尔想趁树根还没让长凳抬不起来之前，把它挪走。

entries.en: Rooker had brought the ladder but forgotten the small brush needed to paint the window frame.
entries.zh: 鲁克带来了梯子，却忘了带刷窗框所需的小刷子。

entries.en: We left our borrowed tent with friends in Ringwood, Victoria, rather than carry it home wet.
entries.zh: 我们把借来的帐篷暂放在维多利亚令伍特的朋友那儿，没有把湿帐篷带回家。

entries.en: Mrs Randell searched beneath the sofa and found the teaspoon we had blamed the children for losing.
entries.zh: 兰德尔太太在沙发底下找到了那把茶匙，我们之前还怪孩子们把它弄丢了。

entries.en: Perlman persuaded the neighbours to postpone their noisy repairs until the children had finished recording their play.
entries.zh: 珀尔曼说服邻居们推迟那些吵闹的修理工作，等孩子们录完自己的戏再动工。

entries.en: Meldrum stopped digging when the spade struck the old drainpipe beneath the flowerbed.
entries.zh: 铲子碰到花坛下面的旧排水管时，梅尔德伦停下了挖掘。

entries.en: Mahmood had washed the curtains but could not remember which room the shorter pair belonged in.
entries.zh: 马哈茂德洗好了窗帘，却想不起较短的那一对该挂在哪个房间。

entries.en: Henrik wanted a second opinion before cutting the only piece of fabric large enough for the cover.
entries.zh: 亨里克想先听听别人的意见，再裁开唯一够大、能做罩子的那块布。

entries.en: Greenhalgh found the glove inside the shopping bag, wrapped around the jar we thought was missing.
entries.zh: 格林哈尔希在购物袋里找到了手套，它包着我们以为不见了的那个罐子。

entries.en: Cleland carried the old chair upstairs despite our warning that its seat had broken.
entries.zh: 尽管我们提醒椅面已经坏了，克莱兰德还是把那把旧椅子搬上了楼。

entries.meaningZh: 卡马森郡〔威尔士原郡名〕
entries.en: The old map of Carmarthenshire was folded around a bundle of letters in the travelling trunk.
entries.zh: 旅行箱里，那张卡马森郡的旧地图包着一捆信件。

entries.en: Anstruther opened the door cautiously because the cat had fallen asleep against the other side.
entries.zh: 安斯特拉瑟小心地开门，因为猫靠着门的另一面睡着了。

entries.en: Alves had repaired the radio, but nobody could agree on what to listen to.
entries.zh: 阿尔维斯修好了收音机，可大家对听什么意见不一。

entries.en: Alessandra offered to carry the basket if someone else would keep the gate open.
entries.zh: 亚历山德拉提出，只要另有人把门扶住，她就帮忙提篮子。

entries.en: The gardener lifted the floribunda from its pot and discovered that the base of the pot had cracked.
entries.zh: 园丁把那株花束月季从花盆里拿出来，发现盆底已经裂了。

entries.en: Westmoreland wanted the table left exactly where it was until the glue on its legs had dried.
entries.zh: 威斯特摩兰希望在桌腿上的胶干透之前，让桌子一直留在原处。

entries.en: Trott arrived with a basket of apples and no idea where the meeting was being held.
entries.zh: 特罗特提着一篮苹果到了，却完全不知道会议在哪儿举行。

entries.en: Thesiger returned the borrowed bowl with a small crack that neither of us remembered seeing before.
entries.zh: 塞西杰归还借去的碗时，碗上有一道小裂纹，我们谁都不记得以前见过。

entries.en: Stagg held everyone back until the frightened kitten had climbed out of the open trunk.
entries.zh: 斯塔格拦住大家，直到那只受惊的小猫从敞开的箱子里爬了出来。

entries.en: Spurling asked us to wait until the photograph had dried before returning it to the album.
entries.zh: 斯珀林请我们等照片干了，再把它放回相册里。

entries.en: The local sinfonietta rehearsed in the hall while volunteers arranged chairs for the evening concert.
entries.zh: 志愿者为晚上的音乐会摆放椅子时，当地的小型交响乐团在大厅里排练。

entries.en: Salazar kept the broken umbrella because its handle fitted the walking stick he was repairing.
entries.zh: 萨拉查留着那把坏伞，因为伞柄正好能装到他正在修的手杖上。

entries.en: The parcel we sent from Perpignan reached our friends before the postcard written the same day.
entries.zh: 我们从佩皮尼昂寄出的包裹，比同一天写的明信片更早到达朋友手里。

entries.en: Patric had borrowed the larger tent without checking whether its poles would fit in the car.
entries.zh: 帕特里克借了那顶较大的帐篷，却没检查帐篷杆能否放进车里。

entries.en: Oliveira found the missing ring beneath the flowerpot we had moved to clean the shelf.
entries.zh: 奥利韦拉在花盆下面找到了丢失的戒指；我们此前为清理搁板，挪动过那个花盆。

entries.en: Nakajima took the photograph outside because the light in the room made its colours difficult to judge.
entries.zh: 中岛把照片拿到外面，因为房间里的光线让人难以判断它的色彩。

entries.en: Mogg offered to replace the broken jug, although we insisted that it had already been cracked.
entries.zh: 莫格提出赔一个水罐，尽管我们坚持说它早就裂了。

entries.en: Lederer wanted the spare room cleared before the piano arrived, not after it blocked the hallway.
entries.zh: 莱德勒希望在钢琴到来之前清空备用房间，而不是等它堵住走廊之后再清。

entries.meaningZh: 耶稣〔诗歌或祈祷中的称呼〕
entries.en: The singer's plea, "Jesu, guide me through this darkness," broke the silence in the chapel.
entries.zh: 歌者恳求道：“耶稣，请引领我走出这片黑暗。”歌声打破了小教堂里的寂静。

entries.en: Hamm had saved the concert programme but could not remember who had performed the final song.
entries.zh: 哈姆留着音乐会节目单，却想不起最后一首歌是谁演唱的。

entries.en: Guilford noticed the leaking roof only after rainwater had filled the empty flowerpot on the shelf.
entries.zh: 雨水灌满搁板上的空花盆后，吉尔福德才注意到屋顶漏了。

entries.en: Foca could not find a matching button, so the repair had to wait until morning.
entries.zh: 福卡找不到配套的纽扣，修补只好等到早上。

entries.en: Our friends in Eastgate returned the borrowed tent with a note about its damaged zip.
entries.zh: 我们在伊斯特盖特的朋友归还了借去的帐篷，还附了一张说明拉链损坏的字条。

entries.meaningZh: 旧式高尔夫球木杆〔brassie 的异体〕
entries.en: He lifted an old brassey from the golf bag and inspected its worn grip.
entries.zh: 他从高尔夫球包里拿出一支旧式木杆，查看磨损的握把。

entries.en: Bolam had brought a clean tablecloth, but it was far too small for the picnic table.
entries.zh: 博勒姆带来了一块干净桌布，可对野餐桌来说实在太小了。

entries.en: Ahmet asked me to carry the empty basket while he went back for the forgotten bread.
entries.zh: 艾哈迈德请我拿着空篮子，他则回去取忘带的面包。

entries.en: Shulman had repaired the clock's case but refused to guess what was wrong with its mechanism.
entries.zh: 舒尔曼修好了钟壳，却不肯猜测钟的机械装置出了什么问题。

entries.en: Palla kept the window open while the freshly painted chairs dried in the empty room.
entries.zh: 刚刷好漆的椅子在空房间里晾干时，帕拉一直开着窗户。

entries.en: Nicolette found the missing address book inside the coat she had packed for the journey.
entries.zh: 尼科莱特在为旅途装好的那件外套里，找到了丢失的通讯录。

entries.en: An error of a few micra was enough to make the two measurements disagree.
entries.zh: 几微米的误差，就足以让两次测量结果不一致。

entries.en: Lott had expected a quiet evening, but the guests arrived carrying a drum and two violins.
entries.zh: 洛特本以为会度过一个安静的晚上，客人却带着一面鼓和两把小提琴来了。

entries.en: Hoch left the broken chair by the door so that nobody would mistake it for a seat.
entries.zh: 霍克把坏椅子放在门边，以免有人误以为它可以坐。

entries.en: The notebooks we used during our visit to Fribourg were still damp when we unpacked them at home.
entries.zh: 我们在家拆开行李时，到访弗里堡时用的那些笔记本还潮着。

entries.en: Durand had wrapped the glasses carefully but left the heavy jug loose in the same box.
entries.zh: 杜兰德仔细包好了玻璃杯，却把沉重的水罐散放在同一个箱子里。

entries.meaningZh: 戴德姆〔马萨诸塞州地名〕
entries.en: We sent the repaired umbrella to our friends in Dedham, Massachusetts, with an apology.
entries.zh: 我们把修好的伞寄给了在马萨诸塞州戴德姆的朋友，还表示了歉意。

entries.en: Ms Craik wanted the portrait moved before the new bookshelf hid half of its frame.
entries.zh: 克雷克女士希望在新书架挡住半个画框之前，把肖像移走。

entries.en: Cathal kept the torn wrapping paper because a phone number had been written on its reverse.
entries.zh: 卡塔尔留着那张撕破的包装纸，因为背面写着一个电话号码。

entries.en: Mr Brody had found a replacement lid, but it was too narrow for the old teapot.
entries.zh: 布洛迪先生找到了替换的盖子，可对那把旧茶壶来说太窄了。

entries.en: Mrs Amherst asked us not to move the cabinet until she had emptied its lowest drawer.
entries.zh: 阿默斯特太太请我们先别搬柜子，等她清空最下面的抽屉再说。

entries.en: She arranged the molluscan shells in separate trays before drawing their different outlines.
entries.zh: 她先把那些软体动物的壳分别摆在托盘里，再画出它们各不相同的轮廓。

entries.meaningZh: 千字节〔计算机数据单位〕
entries.en: The added header increased the file size by less than a kilobyte.
entries.zh: 新增的头部让文件大小增加了不到1 KB（千字节）。

entries.en: The photograph from Ziyang had slipped between the pages of the book we returned to the library.
entries.zh: 那张来自资阳的照片滑进了书页间，而那本书被我们还给了图书馆。

entries.en: Whiteman tried to repair the chair without waking the dog asleep beneath the workbench.
entries.zh: 怀特曼试着修椅子，又不想吵醒在工作台下睡觉的狗。

entries.en: Mr Vitesse had bought new curtains but forgotten to measure the distance between the windows.
entries.zh: 维特斯先生买了新窗帘，却忘了量窗户之间的距离。

entries.en: Vallance asked us to leave the basket open until the freshly washed towels were completely dry.
entries.zh: 瓦兰斯请我们先让篮子敞着，等刚洗好的毛巾彻底干透。

entries.en: We left the borrowed camera with friends in Srinagar and collected it on our return journey.
entries.zh: 我们把借来的相机放在斯利那加的朋友那里，返程时又取了回来。
